spanish: O cuando volviere la carne la viva y se volviere a blanco, y vendrá al sacerdote.
readerNote: hold: clause role — whether the second sequential perfect (ובא, "vendrá") opens the apodosis or whether the first (ונהפך, "se volviere a blanco") still continues the "cuando" protasis is a clause-boundary call the morphology alone does not settle, so both verbs are left in the mood the draft gave them.
